QUOTE: "`library/error.c`, which is generated, not hand-written." and "**Define it in the module's header** in `include/mbedtls/`, with one Doxygen description" and "**Regenerate and commit `library/error.c`** by building, so the Makefile or CMake rule runs."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says error.c is generated and not hand-written. It says a new code means adding the documented #define to the module header and then regenerating error.c, rather than editing it directly.
